title: LookWriting
description: A1356 (B8-11): how written things look - a few marks above the carrier, per carrier kind (medium of content/writing/media.json), paler as the text fades; the content itself shows in words (DE/EN) in the thing's window and when the pointer is over it. Presentation only; what is written and how legible it is stays in the core (WritingSystem).

above_m.description: Height of the marks above the carrier's ground point (metres).

pixel_size_m.description: World size of one pixel of the marks (Label3D pixel size).

font_px.description: Size of the marks in pixels.

faint_below.description: A text this legible or less is 'faint' in words and its marks fade with it (0..1).

hard_below.description: A text this legible or less is 'hard to read' in words (0..1); below faint_below.

media.description: The marks per carrier kind; a medium without an entry shows no marks (its words still show).

marks.description: The marks drawn (a few signs, no letters of a real script - B2741).

color.description: Palette colour id of the marks.
